job.title: [Post] ... looking for an experienced Java Back-End Developer specializing in SAP ... #Hiring #SA…

tailoring.headline: Experienced Java Back-End Developer | SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) Specialist
tailoring.summary: Backend engineer with 5+ years delivering enterprise-grade SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2105/2211) solutions for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Expert in Java, Spring Boot, REST/OCC APIs and microservices, with proven success integrating PIM, ERP and MDM data pipelines. Hands-on with CI/CD, Docker/Kubernetes, production support and techno-functional analysis bridging business and IT.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: experienced Java Back-End Developer specializing in SAP
cover_en.hook: I am excited by Seabin Joseph’s commitment to innovative, sustainable solutions and see a perfect fit for my 5+ years of SAP Commerce Cloud experience at Rockwell Automation and Shell. My deep expertise in Java, Spring Boot and headless SAP Commerce APIs aligns directly with the role’s technical focus.

bullets.label: SAP Commerce Development
bullets.text: Designed and delivered core SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2211) modules—product, catalog, pricing and OMS—using Java and Spring, ensuring high-performance, scalable e-commerce platforms.

bullets.label: API Design & Integration
bullets.text: Built and exposed OCC REST web services and integrated PIM/ERP/MDM data pipelines via DataHub, Hotfolders and Profisee, guaranteeing seamless data flow across global channels.

bullets.label: Techno-Functional Consulting
bullets.text: Worked directly with business stakeholders to analyse requirements, author user stories and functional specs, translating them into concrete SAP Commerce solutions.

bullets.label: Production & CI/CD
bullets.text: Executed CI/CD deployment cycles on SAP Commerce Cloud Portal (CCv2) with Docker/Kubernetes, and provided 24/7 production support, quickly resolving incidents.

cover_en.logistics: Based in Karlsruhe, holds a valid German work permit, serving notice until 15 December 2026, earliest start 16 December 2026. Open to remote, hybrid or on-site collaboration and would welcome a conversation.

tailoring.why_company: Seabin Joseph’s pioneering work in marine sustainability resonates with my passion for building robust, future-proof digital platforms. Your focus on leveraging cutting-edge technology to protect oceans aligns with my experience delivering high-availability SAP Commerce solutions that scale globally. I am eager to contribute my Java and SAP expertise to help accelerate your mission and drive measurable impact for your customers and the environment.
tailoring.motivation_short: I want to join Seabin Joseph to apply my SAP Commerce and Java expertise to a purpose-driven company that innovates for sustainable marine solutions.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hi, I’m Kranti Chavan, a senior SAP Commerce Java developer with 5+ years experience at Rockwell and Shell. I’m keen to bring my expertise to Seabin Joseph’s Java Back-End role. Open to discuss how I can add value.
tailoring.email_subject: Application for experienced Java Back-End Developer – SAP focus
tailoring.email_body: Dear Hiring Team, please find attached my CV and cover letter for the Java Back-End Developer position. With over five years of SAP Commerce Cloud experience at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I am confident I can contribute immediately. I look forward to the opportunity to discuss my fit further.
